comment: A vektra-reflex Lesson ported 1:1 into an RSTP node. mode=guard -> tier 2 (Adept); guard_until was session-scoped in vektra-reflex and has no direct RSTP equivalent, so it is dropped and tier is set by proven evidence instead.

node.title: Safe .env editing
node.pitfall: Rewriting a .env wholesale with write_file/patch mangles escaped or non-ASCII values, and most agent runtimes refuse the write anyway (protected credential store).
node.do: Never rewrite a dotenv file wholesale. Back it up (cp -p), change one line at a time with a targeted sed/patch anchored on the whole line, then diff + od -c to verify bytes.
